newsitem.title: CHINA: China Huludao Zinc plans 90 mln A share offer.
newsitem.headline: China Huludao Zinc plans 90 mln A share offer.

text.p: Major Chinese zinc producer Huludao Zinc Co Ltd plans to issue 90 million local currency A shares in the first half of this year, officials said on Friday.

"We plan to issue the shares, but we are still waiting for approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission," an official said by telephone from the company headquarters in Huludao, in northeastern Liaoning province.
The shares would be listed on the Shenzhen stock exchange in south China, the official said.
Huludao Zinc Co, a unit of the giant Huludao Zinc Factory, was set up as a share-holding company in 1993, he said.
The company produces zinc ingots and electrolytic zinc, the official said, but give no further details.
"The issue could be launched in the May to June period," an official of the Guotai Securities Co, the main underwriter for the planned offer, said by telephone in Beijing.
The share offer was expected to raise about 500 million yuan ($60 million) for further production expansion, he said.
